scope: Conditional uniform-rate scenarios; no local screen statistics or polarized emissivity are measured here.
projection_status: Illustrative directions, not a field-orientation posterior.
emissivity_status: Illustrative unit normalization; multiply by the assumed local polarized emissivity.
spectrum_status: Illustrative power law; no absorption or turnover below 20 MHz.
path_status: Illustrative finite emitting volume, not a measured cloud extent.

scenarios.name: LIC_model26
scenarios.source_location: Slavin and Frisch 2008, Table 2 B0 and Table 5 n_e, model 26.
scenarios.status: One photoionization-model pair; extending B0 as a uniform local field is an additional assumption.
